posts.title: Introducing Ithibati: passkey authentication for Elixir
posts.description: Ithibati is a small Elixir library for passkey authentication: accounts, WebAuthn credentials, recovery codes and revocable sessions. It started as the login of another project of mine and grew into something I wanted to use more than once. Here's what it does and how it fits into a Phoenix app.
